description: 401GO is a fintech retirement benefit platform. The company's proprietary automation technology substantially simplifies the setup and administration of a 401(k), reducing day-to-day work and driving down costs.

Abstract Security has created a revolutionary platform, equipped with an AI-powered assistant, to better centralize the management of security analytics. Abstract transcends next-gen SIEM solutions by correlating data in real-time between data streams. As a result, compliance and security data can be leveraged separately to increase detection effectiveness and lower costs.
tagline: THE COMPLETE DATA PLATFORM FOR SECURITY

description: The mission of ACS is to build products and services that enable our forces to maneuver safely and accomplish their mission—whatever it is. They do this by reimagining the weapon systems of the past and infusing them with technologies of the present.
tagline: Autonomous Robotics for the Defense Space

description: Appdome provides a mobile integration platform to offer integration of multiple third-party functions to existing mobile apps. The company’s platform offers no-code mobile implementation options, enabling app developers to complete mobile integration projects in seconds, eliminate manual development and ease mobile integration maintenance.

Arctic Wolf is a global leader in security operations, enabling customers to manage their cyber risk in the face of modern cyber attacks via a premier cloud-native security operations platform. The Arctic Wolf Security Operations Cloud ingests and analyzes more than 4.5 trillion security events a week to help enable cyber defense at an unprecedented capacity and scale, empowering customers of virtually any size across a wide range of industries to feel confident in their security posture, readiness and long-term resilience.

Braze is the global leader in Marketing Automation for Apps. The company’s customer engagement platform is built for today’s mobile-first world. Braze’s platform allows marketers at leading brands to create live views of their customers that stream and process historical, in-the-moment, and predictive data in an interactive feedback loop, so immediate action on insights can be taken with relevant messaging across mobile and web.

Bugcrowd’s crowd-sourced security platform helps organizations with a customized security testing program to bolster their security posture. The company’s platform offers cost-effective security testing programs to manage bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, and next-gen pen test programs — enabling clients to commission a customized security testing program that fits their specific requirements.

Harness is the only end-to-end platform for complete software delivery designed to provide a simple, safe and secure way for engineering and DevOps teams to release applications into production. Harness uses machine learning to detect the quality of deployments and automatically roll back failed ones, saving time and reducing the need for custom scripting and manual oversight.

JustiFi is the payment platform built for vertical SaaS platforms. JustiFi's managed orchestration layer optimizes payments to help businesses achieve world-class monetization. Leveraging 50+ years of industry experience and expertise, the JustiFi team eliminates barriers put up by traditional processors, taking partners beyond payment processing to reach their full potential.

Order developed an inventory purchasing platform intended to streamline and facilitate enterprise purchasing processes. The platform links vendors to manage all orders on an instant basis, control spending and centralize purchasing securely, allowing businesses to analyze multiple vendor accounts in a hassle-free manner.

Oxide has developed a cloud hyperscale technology intended to build better quality servers. The company leverages technology to build servers which increase the density, efficiency, cost, reliability, manageability, and security of computer infrastructure, enabling clients to use better computer infrastructure.

RentSpree provides an award-winning software used in all 50 states as a universal tenant screening process and renter management platform. They also maintain a robust affiliate program and rental screening API that enables any platform to incorporate an automated screening process in as little as one week.

Total Expert has developed a marketing operating system designed for mortgage loan officers, title companies and real estate agents. The company’s platform aligns marketing, sales, and compliance in a single system of record, allowing salespeople to grow their marketing and sales efforts while ensuring they stay compliant with complex regulations.

Vertical Insure is the embedded insurance platform built for vertical SaaS platforms. The company offers customized insurance options that are 100% built around each business and its customers, resulting in added value and new revenue without any extra overhead.

Yardstik is the creator of the Human Trust Platform, helping organizations prevent fraud, verify identity and build trust across the entire workforce lifecycle. The company brings together fraud detection, background screening and credential verification in a single solution. What has traditionally been treated as a cost center, Yardstik transforms into a revenue-generating opportunity for its platform customers.
tagline: Background Check and Identity Verification Platform

description: Zivian Health is the leading healthcare SaaS platform for healthcare organizations to connect nurse practitioners (NPs) and physician assistants (PAs) with highly vetted collaborating physicians to address critical staffing shortages, support treatment plans and ensure compliance.
tagline: Platform for Healthcare Providers and Organizations
